jobs.label: Humvee interceptor rocket
jobs.description: A lightweight shorter guided interceptor rocket, 220px long, pale steel body with muted olive center band, black pointed seeker nose NORTH and small cruciform fin tops. Compact icy-white/amber exhaust at SOUTH tail under 85px long, four flicker poses. Distinct from larger SAM missile, very narrow silhouette, no logos or labels.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Top-down RTS projectile animation for Age of Fronts Modern Age, matching the weathered olive-steel realistic hand-painted style of the supplied reference. Reference is style only, replace its subject. A precise 2x2 atlas, 1254x1254 RGBA, FOUR 627x627 cells read row-major, ONE SAME projectile per cell with its nose pointing screen NORTH/top and tail SOUTH/bottom. Exact 90-degree vertical orthographic camera; longitudinal body lies in image plane. Identical sharp rigid body coordinates and scale across all four cells; only restrained tail exhaust/tracer flicker changes. Exterior game prop, no cutaway or technical labels, text, flags, background, clouds or target. Transparent alpha and at least 65px clear margin in each cell. Keep complete projectile+tail effect no larger than 440px high, centered in each cell, outer80px margin. A lightweight shorter guided interceptor rocket, 220px long, pale steel body with muted olive center band, black pointed seeker nose NORTH and small cruciform fin tops. Compact icy-white/amber exhaust at SOUTH tail under 85px long, four flicker poses. Distinct from larger SAM missile, very narrow silhouette, no logos or labels.
